note: Cherry-made rewards: the welcome Gems, the daily quests (ids 9001-9005 in CherryQuestFirst/Last; names, descriptions, Gem rewards and trigger keys), the season event quests (ids 9101-9303), the Garden Requests (ids 9401-9406; all names, descriptions, goals, triggers and rewards Cherry-made) and request_rules (daily limit, free/paid invite and refresh costs), the sequential Garden Episodes (ids 9501-9507; all chapter names, descriptions, order, goals and rewards Cherry-made), the hearts rule, the mail rules (the sender 'Cherry Staff') and the avatar birthday reward (birthday: claim window in days, the gacha discount percent and how long it lasts; the birthday itself is the avatar's creation date, and the reward's keys and turn numbers are the client's own). Quest icon/npc_icon files are original PNGs from UIResource/UIImage_hd served under /cherry/quest/, while which icon or portrait is assigned to each quest is Cherry-made. No original quest id, Episode, Request, goal or reward exists in libgame.so or the archives (phaseD quests.md, quests-tabs-20261125/spec.md). Exception: the hearts row name and its 20-heart goal are the original quest as the owner remembers it (2026-11-25); its reward is still Cherry-made.
